headline: Committee recommends adoption of amended Resolution 24-161 on recycled R1 water

meeting.body: Maui County Council Water and Infrastructure Committee
meeting.voteItem: Amendment to item number three of the revised resolution
meeting.summary: The committee passed two changes to the resolution, each eight to zero, including one asking the administration to invest in R1 production at the Kahului, Molokaʻi and Lānaʻi plants. The recommendation had seven ayes, one member excused; the chair said it will move on.
meeting.recap: The Department of Water Supply director said the department strongly supports the item.[[0:08:37]] A testifier said she lost her home in the fire and called the item a priority.[[0:13:21]] Another testifier said private users of R1 water should pay for its pipes and operations, with public uses served first.[[0:30:00]] The environmental management director said South Maui reuses about 62 to 63 percent of its treated wastewater.[[1:31:13]] The director said West Maui reuses about 50 percent.[[1:31:30]] A council member raised concern that the resolution did not specify affordable housing.[[1:40:37]] That change, with cultural uses added, passed eight to zero, with one member excused.[[2:23:10]] A second change asks the administration to invest in R1 production at the Kahului, Molokaʻi and Lānaʻi plants.[[2:24:14]] That change also passed eight to zero.[[2:25:29]] One council member voted no in the roll call.[[2:26:28]] The committee voted seven ayes to recommend adoption of the amended resolution, with one member excused.[[2:26:56]]
decided: The committee approved a change asking the administration to invest in R1 production at the Kahului, Molokaʻi and Lānaʻi plants.
meeting.next: The environmental management director offered to give another R1 presentation to the council and community if asked. The chair said the resolution will move on.

moments.q: "the Department of Water Supply is strongly in support of this item."

trackerIssues.title: Using recycled R1 water for irrigation and firefighting

issues.oneLine: Resolution 24-161 urges the administration to make and deliver more recycled R1 water to save drinking water for housing.
issues.why: The chair said drought and water shortages have put West Maui affordable housing projects in limbo.
issues.next: The chair said the resolution will move on.
issues.brief: The environmental management director said the next West Maui phase takes R1 water up to a county-owned reservoir at the 700-foot level.[[#1]] The environmental management director said R1 water costs less than drinking water, but its price does not fully cover operating costs.[[#2]]
